description: Validate a WebVTT or SRT caption file for syntax errors, timing overlaps, excessive caption rate, and missing speaker identification. Helps ensure media accessibility compliance (WCAG 1.2.2, 1.2.4).

filePath.description: Absolute path to the .vtt or .srt caption file

name: validate_caption_file

component.description: Component or template, when the defect repeats.

evidence.description: The offending markup, value or measurement.

location.description: Where the defect is, precisely enough to open.

notes.description: Anything a person must decide, and anything that could not be checked.

passed.description: Checks that ran and found nothing, so 'clean' is distinguishable from 'not checked'.

title: Validate Caption File
